note: Synthetic tasks and scripted model traces. No customer data, no secrets.

scenarios.title: Normal task
scenarios.summary: A short facilities note finishes on the frontier tier, under the soft budget.
scenarios.instruction: Write a one-paragraph status note for the open facilities tickets in queue FAC. Use only tool results.

steps.content: Three facilities tickets are open in queue FAC. FAC-1842: HVAC filter overdue in building C. FAC-1848: the loading-dock door sensor is intermittent. FAC-1851: the east stairwell light is out. These ids are synthetic.

scenarios.title: Runaway loop
scenarios.summary: The model calls search_inventory with the same arguments until the repeat limit opens the breaker.
scenarios.instruction: Find the on-hand count for SKU HX-204 at warehouse south, then stop.

scenarios.title: Budget overrun
scenarios.summary: A synthetic usage dump lands in the prompt. The next call is projected over the $0.50 hard cap and is not sent.
scenarios.instruction: Summarize 30 days of API usage for synthetic account acct-14 and recommend a monthly cap.

scenarios.title: Provider outage
scenarios.summary: The frontier provider returns HTTP 503. The task finishes on the local tier.
scenarios.instruction: Write a one-paragraph status note for the open facilities tickets in queue FAC. A local model is acceptable if the frontier provider is down.

steps.content: Local model note. Open FAC tickets: FAC-1842 HVAC filter overdue in building C, FAC-1848 dock door sensor intermittent, FAC-1851 east stairwell light out. Filter parts are waiting, a sensor reset is scheduled, and a lamp is on the dock. These ids are synthetic.
